अंडमान और निकोबार प्रशासन
ANDAMAN AND NICOBAR ADMINISTRATION
SECRETARIAT सचिवालय
********

#/texts/1.label: paragraph
#/texts/1.full_gt_text: Sri Vijaya Puram, dated the 31st August, 2026

#/texts/3.label: paragraph
#/texts/3.full_gt_text:
It has been observed that the designated Link Officers have been delaying the
disposal of e-files pertaining to other Departments, thereby causing constraints in
the smooth functioning of day-to-day official work, including matters of utmost
urgency.

#/texts/4.label: paragraph
#/texts/4.full_gt_text:
The Competent Authority has viewed the matter seriously and has directed
that all e-files received by the designated Link Officers shall be attended to and
disposed of immediately, without any delay.

#/texts/5.label: paragraph
#/texts/5.full_gt_text: Further, officers who are on duty-cum-tour to the mainland/inter-Islands shall continue to perform their routine duties and ensure timely disposal of e-files through e-Office.

#/texts/6.label: paragraph
#/texts/6.full_gt_text: The above instructions shall be adhered to strictly.

#/texts/8.label: paragraph
#/texts/8.full_gt_text: This issues with the approval of the Competent Authority.

#/texts/12.label: paragraph
#/texts/12.full_gt_text: 1. The Sr. PS to Lt. Governor, Lok Niwas, Sri Vijaya Puram.

#/texts/13.label: paragraph
#/texts/13.full_gt_text: 2. The PS to CS, A & N Administration, Sri Vijaya Puram.

#/texts/14.label: paragraph
#/texts/14.full_gt_text: 3. The PCCF, ANI, A & N Administration, Sri Vijaya Puram.

#/texts/15.label: paragraph
#/texts/15.full_gt_text: 4. The DGP, A & N Police, A & N Administration, Sri Vijaya Puram.

#/texts/16.label: paragraph
#/texts/16.full_gt_text: 5. All Comm-cum-Secretary, A & N Administration, Sri Vijaya Puram.

#/texts/17.label: paragraph
#/texts/17.full_gt_text: 6. All Secretaries/ Spl. Secretaries/Jt. Secretaries/ Deputy Secretaries, A & N Administration, SVP.

#/texts/18.label: paragraph
#/texts/18.full_gt_text: 7. All HOD's A & N Administration, SVP.

#/texts/19.label: paragraph
#/texts/19.full_gt_text: 8. The EDP Section, to upload this Circular to A & N Administration's website.
